title: Maharashtra River-Level Forecast and Flood-Stage Warning
target: Maximum valid observed river level over (issue time, issue time +24h], metres; predict change from current.
issue_time: 08:00 IST once per day; 24 hourly future bins must have actual observations.
selection: Minimum validation score: 0.5 macro-station MAE overall +0.5 macro-station MAE on target peaks at/above official warning. Ties overall MAE then fewer training-weight changes. Baselines participate in selection. Test/calibration never choose the predictor.
calibration: 90% nominal empirical absolute-residual range, from separate 2022 calibration rows per station. No exchangeability or guaranteed future coverage claim; report test coverage.
quality: Fixed wide bounds [zero gauge RL-10, danger+30]m; unresolved conflicting duplicates missing; >10m/hour accepted-history jumps missing; unchanged run >72h stale from that point forward. No decimal/datum repairs. Features forward-fill at most2h; >=65 actually observed past72 hourly bins; future label bins never filled. Quality rules do not use model scores or future values.
limits: Historical replay, not live alerts. Source records were inspected in feasibility research. Contiguous hourly flood records are not independent floods. Only three known gauges. Archive corrections/availability may differ from what was issued in real time. Official threshold datum/history assumed consistent for selected series; source QC cannot prove every value. No rainfall predictor: co-located gauge rain is sparse/nonzero-only; it is not filled with zeros. Availability favours high-frequency observation seasons; excluded/missing windows are not normal labels.
